title: Fix pre-existing SPA TypeScript build errors blocking npm run build -w src/ui
objective: Resolve the 18 pre-existing TypeScript errors in src/ui so `npm run build -w src/ui` (tsc -b && vite build) exits 0, unblocking the AC-001/V-001 SPA-build clause, the vercel.json buildCommand, and any future deployment. The errors are latent breakage that was masked by a stale src/ui/node_modules/.tmp tsbuildinfo which let `tsc -b` skip the type pass; a clean install surfaces them.
scope: Fix the SortableTh generic misuse so callers may pass any sortable field key, not just 'name' (SortableTh.tsx + UserListPage.tsx and any other caller)
Remove the now-redundant src/ui/package-lock.json (superseded by the workspaces root lockfile)
out_of_scope: Any visual/UI redesign or behavior change - this is a type-correctness fix only
Upgrading recharts, react, or @types/react major versions
Migrating the SPA to Supabase Auth (T-018)
implementation_details: Preserve runtime behavior exactly: `npx vite build` already exits 0, so bundling is fine - only the tsc type gate fails. No rendered output should change.

Prefer correcting the types at the source (generic parameters, proper narrowing) over casting; do NOT silence errors with `any`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, or by weakening tsconfig strictness. If a library typing is genuinely wrong, use a narrow, commented local type assertion.
SortableTh is generic over the field key; the current declaration collapses to 'name'. Fix the generic so each call site infers its own union.
Do not delete or skip useClientSort.test.tsx to make it compile - repair it so it still asserts the sorting behavior it was written for.
Do not disable or relax noUncheckedIndexedAccess; fix the indexing sites.
After fixing, delete src/ui/node_modules/.tmp (or run a clean install) and confirm the build is genuinely green rather than incrementally cached.
files: src/ui/src/ (recharts chart components, LegacyRef site, indexing sites)

unit: Repaired useClientSort.test.tsx passes and still asserts its original sorting behavior
integration: `npm run build -w src/ui` exits 0 from a state with no stale tsbuildinfo (clean .tmp)
`npm run typecheck` still exits 0 for the backend
A grep/scripted check asserts no new `any`, `@ts-ignore`, or `@ts-expect-error` was introduced in src/ui as part of this fix
e2e: Existing Playwright suite untouched (still points at the .NET stack until T-043)

findings.summary: SPA tests cannot run under the npm workspace: vitest is hoisted to the root while jsdom stays nested in src/ui/node_modules, so `npm test -w src/ui` fails at collection with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for 'jsdom'.
findings.detail: Pre-existing consequence of the T-001 workspace restructure, not of this task's type fixes: the failure occurs before any test file is loaded, so it is independent of source content. Root package-lock.json correctly records src/ui/node_modules/jsdom (136 nested entries) and the package is present on disk, but vitest resolves its environment package relative to its own hoisted location (root/node_modules/vitest), where jsdom is absent. `npm install` reports 'up to date' and does not fix it. To verify this task's runtime behavior, a temporary directory junction (node_modules\jsdom -> src\ui\node_modules\jsdom) was created, the suite was run green (96 files, 492 tests), and the junction was REMOVED, leaving the tree exactly as found. A durable fix (hoisting jsdom, adding it at root, or pinning vitest per-workspace) is needed before SPA tests can run in CI, and should be tracked in the CI task (T-010).
findings.resolution: Root cause confirmed by orchestrator: vitest hoisted to root node_modules while jsdom remained in src/ui/node_modules, so root-resolved vitest could not resolve jsdom (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND from node_modules/vitest). Fixed durably by declaring jsdom ^25.0.1 (the version already used by src/ui) in ROOT devDependencies - a workspaces hoisting fix, not a new library. Verified: npm test -w src/ui now exits 0 with 96 files / 492 tests passing, no directory junction or workaround. Root lint, backend typecheck, backend tests, and the SPA build all remain green.

findings.summary: `npm run lint -w src/ui` exits 1 on a pre-existing error unrelated to this task: '_removed' is assigned a value but never used (TenantFormPage.tsx:161).
findings.detail: 1 error + 6 warnings total. TenantFormPage.tsx was not modified by this task, and none of the five files changed here appear anywhere in the lint output. SPA lint is not part of this task's test_plan (which gates on build, backend typecheck, backend test, and the suppression grep), so it was left as found rather than fixed, to avoid scope creep. Root `npm run lint` (backend tree) exits 0.
findings.resolution: Fixed at the lint-policy level rather than by rewriting working code. TenantFormPage.tsx:161 uses the standard rest-sibling omit idiom `const { [field]: _removed, ...rest } = current` and the author already followed the underscore-prefix convention, but src/ui/eslint.config.js never enabled it. Added @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars options (argsIgnorePattern/varsIgnorePattern/caughtErrorsIgnorePattern '^_', ignoreRestSiblings true) at unchanged 'error' severity. Verified: npm run lint -w src/ui exits 0 with zero errors; SPA tests (492) and SPA build remain green. Source file untouched.

history.message: Created by orchestrator at human request to resolve blocker finding F-001-1 on T-001. Human chose option (a): fix the SPA type errors rather than amend AC-001/V-001. Unblocks the AC-001 `npm run build -w src/ui` clause and the vercel.json buildCommand.
Delegated to Implementor immediately per human instruction to fix now.

All 18 errors fixed at the type source; zero suppressions and zero new type assertions. (1) ROOT CAUSE of 14 errors (13 SortableTh call sites + the useClientSort test) was NOT SortableTh, which was already correctly generic: useClientSort declared `initial: SortState<F>`, so a call passing `{ field: 'name' }` gave a higher-priority inference candidate that collapsed F to the literal 'name', after which every other column key was rejected. Fixed with one change - `initial: SortState<NoInfer<F>>` (TS 6.0.3) - so F is inferred from the accessors map alone, the authoritative set of sortable fields. useClientSort.test.tsx needed NO edit: it compiles and passes unchanged, still asserting all four original behaviors (case-insensitive ordering, direction flip, new-column-ascending, nulls-last in both directions). (2) noUncheckedIndexedAccess in DonutChartWidget: NEUTRAL_ROTATION typed as `readonly [string, ...string[]]` so the tuple has a statically guaranteed element 0, plus `?? NEUTRAL_ROTATION[0]` (unreachable at runtime for a non-negative render index). (3) LegacyRef in useMeasuredWidth: the return annotation `RefObject<T | null>` was wrong for @types/react 18, where RefObject<T> ALREADY means `current: T | null`; because RefObject is measured as covariant, RefObject<T|null> is rejected where a DOM ref prop wants RefObject<T> despite being structurally identical. Corrected to `RefObject<T>`, which is exactly what useRef<T>(null) returns. Sole consumer is LineChartWidget. (4) recharts Tooltip formatter: yTickFormatter is (number)=>string but Formatter passes ValueType|undefined; added a typeof-number guard wrapper using the root-exported `TooltipValueType`, kept undefined when no formatter is supplied so Recharts default rendering is preserved. (5) recharts LabelList content: local BrokerPointLabelProps was structurally incompatible with the cartesian-or-polar `ViewBox` union; retyped the renderer against recharts' own root-exported `LabelProps` and narrowed the polar shape out with an `'x' in box` type guard instead of casting. Also deleted the redundant src/ui/package-lock.json per F-001-5.

`npm run build -w src/ui` EXIT 0 - run after `rm -rf src/ui/node_modules/.tmp` so it is proven green from a no-stale-tsbuildinfo state rather than on cached incremental output (775 modules transformed, built in 390ms). `npx tsc -b --force` EXIT 0 with zero errors (down from 18). `npm run typecheck` (backend) EXIT 0. `npm test` (backend) EXIT 0 - 7 files, 101 tests, T-001 suite unaffected. `npm run typecheck -w src/ui` EXIT 0. Root `npm run lint` EXIT 0. Suppression check: 0 occurrences of @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/@ts-nocheck across ALL of src/ui/src, and no `any` type and no new `as` assertion in any of the 5 changed files (the only 'any' match is the English word in a comment; the two `as` assertions in DonutChartWidget:51 and BrokerMatrixScatter:140 are pre-existing untouched lines). RUNTIME BEHAVIOR VERIFIED: full SPA suite 96 files / 492 tests all passing, covering useClientSort, SortableTh, LineChartWidget, DonutChartWidget and BrokerMatrixScatter - required a temporary jsdom junction (see F-045-1) which was removed afterwards. NOT PASSING (pre-existing, unrelated): `npm test -w src/ui` without the junction (F-045-1) and `npm run lint -w src/ui` (F-045-2, error is in TenantFormPage.tsx, untouched). NOT RUN: Playwright e2e (out of scope per test_plan; still points at the .NET stack).

Evaluator PASS (evaluate-task-completeness + evaluate-tests-code + security-review-task). Independently executed: rm -rf src/ui/node_modules/.tmp then npm run build -w src/ui EXIT 0, with tsconfig.app.tsbuildinfo and tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo regenerated during that run — the type pass provably executed uncached (the exact stale-cache failure mode that originally hid the 18 errors cannot have masked this result). npm test -w src/ui EXIT 0 with exactly 96 files/492 tests (the F-045-1 jsdom root-devDependency fix verified durable, no junction present). npm run lint -w src/ui EXIT 0 (0 errors, 6 pre-existing warnings). Backend unaffected: npm run typecheck EXIT 0, npm run lint EXIT 0, npm test EXIT 0 (101 tests). GENUINENESS REVIEW of all five fixes: (1) useClientSort `initial: SortState<NoInfer<F>>` is a real inference correction, not a cast — F now derives solely from the accessors map; the unchanged useClientSort.test.tsx exercises it (toggle('count') from an initial {field:'name'} would not compile if F still collapsed) and still asserts all four original behaviors. (2) DonutChartWidget NEUTRAL_ROTATION retyped as non-empty tuple `readonly [string, ...string[]]` with `?? NEUTRAL_ROTATION[0]` — a legitimate noUncheckedIndexedAccess fix preserving identical runtime values. (3) useMeasuredWidth return annotation corrected from RefObject<T|null> to RefObject<T> — matches what useRef<T>(null) actually returns under @types/react 18; annotation-only. (4) LineChartWidget tooltip formatter wraps yTickFormatter in a typeof-number guard against TooltipValueType; numeric path identical, undefined passthrough preserved. (5) BrokerMatrixScatter label renderer retyped against recharts' own LabelProps with an `'x' in box` cartesian type guard instead of a cast. ZERO suppressions: grep of src/ui/src finds no @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/@ts-nocheck; the only two `as` assertions in the changed files (DonutChartWidget:51, BrokerMatrixScatter:140) are onClick event-payload casts on untouched lines, unrelated to the 18 fixed errors. Runtime behavior: no test in the 492-test suite changed and all pass; every changed component (useClientSort/SortableTh/LineChartWidget/DonutChartWidget/BrokerMatrixScatter) is covered. src/ui/package-lock.json confirmed deleted. src/ui/eslint.config.js no-unused-vars underscore-ignore options confirmed at unchanged error severity. tsconfig strictness untouched. Security: no dependency additions beyond human-approved jsdom at root; no secrets; SPA bundle scan clean. Both findings verified RESOLVED as recorded.
